newsitem.title: JAPAN: North Korea says arrested U.S. citizen as spy.
newsitem.headline: North Korea says arrested U.S. citizen as spy.

text.p: North Korea said on Sunday it had arrested a U.S. citizen as a spy working for South Korea.
The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said Evan Carl Hunzike was arrested on August 24 by a North Korean security organisation after he crossed into North Korea.
KCNA said Hunzike crossed the Amnok River into North Korea but did not identify him further.

"On August 24, a public security organ of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea arrested a U.S. citizen, Evan Carl Hunzike, when he illegally entered the DPRK, crossing the Amnok River," KCNA said in a communique, seen in Tokyo.
"He admitted that he is a U.S. citizen and that he illegally entered the DPRK for the purpose of getting information on its domestic situation.

"It has been proved by investigation that he was sent for espionage by South Korea's Agency for National Security planning. He will have to take appropriate penal responsibility under the DPRK criminal law," KCNA said.
